slides.title: Applying Concepts
slides.body:
Applying Concepts
Your Journey
Once you are good at applying the concepts, you are more than halfway to becoming a developer
slides.notes:
Becoming a developer is like learning a Cycle. First you need to know about parts - pedal,brakes, handle. But just knowing them is not enough 
You need to start to ride the cycle slowly. So even you are slowly riding the cycle - it means you are already in a way of becoming a good rider

Like that only - Learning concepts is not enough to become a developer. You need to apply that concept to solve coding questions and real problems
So once you are applying that concepts to solve problems – that means you are already more than halfway to become a developer    

And also while going forward, you need to work on applications that are similar to real-world projects

slides.title: Topics to be Covered
slides.body:
Introduction to React & JSX
Components and Props
Lists and Keys
State and Events
Handling Side Effects
Routing using react-router
Authentication & Context
React JS
slides.notes:
And to give you an overview of what all different things we’ll learn in React JS… 
First, we’ll get to understand what this ReactJS is and what’s JSX
Then we’ll learn about the components and Props concepts. 
List and keys
State and class components. 

We’ll also talk about the react lifecycle methods,
How to route using react-router and authentication as well.
